CLINICAL PATHWAY

Five steps. Clear clinical boundaries.

A seamless co-management pathway designed so optometrists and consultant surgeons do exactly what each does best.

1
YOUR PRACTICE

Patient Referral

Submit patient clinical details and biometry via the Syndesis portal in under 2 minutes.

2
EYEPROS

Consultant Assessment

Pre-operative workup and informed consent conducted personally by the named surgeon.

3
EYEPROS

Day-Case Surgery

Modern surgical episode performed in our surgical centre by your patient's named NHS consultant.

4
EYEPROS → YOU

7-Day Discharge

Discharge summary, surgical notes, and medication plan transmitted securely within 7 days.

5
YOUR PRACTICE

4-Week Co-Management

Conduct post-op review and new refraction. Submit completion report to receive your £250 fee.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Partnership clarity for your practice

Straightforward answers on clinical governance, payment terms, and co-management protocols.

The £250 fee is paid per eye for managing the 4-week post-operative review and refractive assessment of private and self-pay cataract patients. Upon submitting your clinical assessment findings via the Syndesis portal, payment is settled directly to your practice bank account via BACS. There are no volume minimums or quotas to qualify.
Yes, absolutely. Our Shared Care Agreement legally protects your patient relationship. EyePros exclusively provides the surgical episode and returns the patient to your consulting room within 7 days for post-op care. We do not provide primary optometric services, spectacles, or contact lenses — all future dispensing remains 100% with your practice.
We provide complete training for your practice team on using the Syndesis digital referral platform, submitting scans, and tracking patient milestones. Additionally, partner optometrists have direct telephone access to the operating consultant ophthalmologist for clinical queries, patient triage, and peer-to-peer discussion.
EyePros retains full surgical indemnity and acute post-operative medical responsibility. If you or your patient has any clinical concerns, you have direct priority telephone access to the named consultant surgeon who performed the operation, with emergency same-day review at our surgical centre if required.
Any GOC-registered optometrist in an independent practice can participate. Standard diagnostic equipment (slit lamp, applanation tonometry, visual field analyser) is sufficient for post-operative reviews. An OCT is beneficial but not mandatory. Our clinical team provides a straightforward induction on post-op assessment protocols.
Simply complete the practice enquiry form above or call our partnership desk on 0333 77 272 77. We will send the full legal agreement, clinical governance schedule, and onboarding documentation for your review within one business day.
